name: Emilia Sophie Kingston
original_name: エミリア・ソフィー・キングストン
source:
She is the daughter of an upper-class aristocrat and has been educated as a lady. She is sensitive, intelligent, and beautiful, but has a strong sense of class and naturally looks down on lower-class people.

By nature, she is an honest girl, and her class consciousness is the result of her parents' strict discipline. In front of her strict parents or at social gatherings, she acts like a very elegant lady. 

However, she can become a selfish spoiled brat to those whom she has forgiven (her siblings).

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/7363]official site[/url]]
